title: Pais patent test at Pax River had no definitive results
summary: Eric Burles tells of Pais patent test at Pax River had no definitive results, about 2025 at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

plain: A US congressman, Eric Burlison, says that around 2025 he learned about tests at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, a Navy air base in Maryland where aircraft are tested. According to Burlison, officials admitted they had built and tested one of the devices described in patents by an inventor named Salvatore Pais, he believes the anti-gravity one, but they got no clear results. It matters to the people telling it because a working device of that kind would mean gravity itself could be engineered.
